FAQ: Fastest Land Animal

Q: What is the fastest land animal in the world?
A: The cheetah is the fastest land animal, capable of reaching speeds up to 70 mph (112 km/h).

FAQ: Internet of Things (IoT)

Q: How does the Internet of Things (IoT) work?
A: IoT works by embedding electronics, software, sensors, and connectivity into physical devices, vehicles, home appliances, and other items. This enables these objects to connect and exchange data, creating opportunities for more direct integration of the physical world into computer-based systems.
